senses.gloss: same, only in part. pass. Pa. מְהַגַּן, f. מְהַגְּנָא = מְהוּגָּן, v. preced.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 24:12">Targ. Y. Gen. XXIV, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 24:26">26</cite>.

<cite ref="Taanit 22b:6">Taan. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>מילתא דלא מה׳</he> an unbecoming word.—Pl. m. <he>מְהַגְּנִין</he>.
